title: Polynomial advice-time classes
statement: The union, over all natural numbers $c$ and $d$, of the classes of languages decidable with advice of length $n^d$ in time bounded by a constant multiple of $n^c$ equals the union, over all natural numbers $d$, of the classes of languages decidable with advice of length $n^d$ in constant time up to a constant factor.
